package extract_test

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"slices"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgtype"
	"github.com/riverqueue/river/rivertype"

	"travelinbox.app/backend/internal/extract"
	"travelinbox.app/backend/internal/jobs"
)

const (
	stubToken = "stub-token"
	// stubScopelessToken is a valid token outside the jobs scope.
	stubScopelessToken = "stub-token-without-scope"
	// stubQuota is the stub's quota per window.
	stubQuota = 1000
	// stubKeep is how long the stub keeps a job, the contract's 24 hours.
	stubKeep = 24 * time.Hour
)

// stubVersion is the service_version of every stub job.
var stubVersion = "stub+" + extract.FakeServiceVersion

// reply is one scripted HTTP answer of the stub.
type reply struct {
	status int
	header map[string]string
	body   string
}

// stubPart is one multipart part the stub received.
type stubPart struct {
	contentType string
	data        []byte
}

// stub is an httptest extraction service speaking
// docs/EXTRACTION-SERVICE-CONTRACT.md and shared/extraction-service-api.yaml.
// By default it answers from a Fake: a submit runs the Fake on the document
// part and answers 202 with the queued job, the first poll of a job says
// running and the next one gives the Fake's verdict, its feedback marked as
// the judge's.
//
// Like the service it honours Idempotency-Key (a repeat returns the existing
// job with Idempotency-Replayed: true and runs nothing; a different body is
// 422), counts jobs against a quota it reports in X-Quota-Remaining and
// X-Quota-Reset and at GET /v1/quota, and with retention none answers 404
// once a terminal status has been read.
//
// submit and poll, when set, answer instead with scripted replies; n counts
// their calls from 1.
type stub struct {
	srv    *httptest.Server
	fake   extract.Fake
	submit func(n int) reply
	poll   func(n int) reply
	// limit is the quota per window, stubQuota unless a test changes it.
	limit int
	// noQuota answers GET /v1/quota with 404, as a service without it.
	noQuota bool
	// lose drops the connection after submit n created its job, as a
	// response lost on its way back.
	lose func(n int) bool

	mu      sync.Mutex
	submits int
	polls   int
	runs    int                   // jobs created, one Fake run each
	parts   map[string][]stubPart // of the last submit
	keys    []string              // the Idempotency-Key of every submit
	jobs    map[string]*stubJob
	byKey   map[string]*stubJob
	answers []stubAnswer // every answer that was not scripted
}

type stubJob struct {
	id        string
	digest    string // of the parts, to tell a repeat from a mismatch
	res       extract.Result
	retention string
	status    string
	created   time.Time
	finished  *time.Time
	polls     int
	gone      bool // content deleted: a terminal status read with retention none
}

// stubAnswer is one answer of the stub's own, kept for TestStubContract.
type stubAnswer struct {
	path   string
	status int
	header http.Header
	body   []byte
}

func newStub(t *testing.T) *stub {
	t.Helper()
	s := &stub{limit: stubQuota, jobs: map[string]*stubJob{}, byKey: map[string]*stubJob{}}
	s.srv = httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(s.serve))
	t.Cleanup(s.srv.Close)
	return s
}

// service returns a client of the stub that polls quickly.
func (s *stub) service() *extract.Service {
	return &extract.Service{URL: s.srv.URL, Token: stubToken, PollInterval: 5 * time.Millisecond}
}

func (s *stub) counts() (submits, polls int) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.submits, s.polls
}

// sentKeys is the Idempotency-Key of every submit so far, "" for none.
func (s *stub) sentKeys() []string {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return slices.Clone(s.keys)
}

// created is the number of jobs the stub created, each one Fake run.
func (s *stub) created() int {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	return s.runs
}

func (s *stub) serve(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	switch r.Header.Get("Authorization") {
	case "Bearer " + stubToken:
	case "Bearer " + stubScopelessToken:
		write(w, reply{status: http.StatusForbidden, body: `{"error":{"code":"forbidden","message":"token outside its scope"}}`})
		return
	default:
		write(w, reply{status: http.StatusUnauthorized, body: `{"error":{"code":"unauthorized","message":"bad token"}}`})
		return
	}
	switch {
	case r.Method == http.MethodPost && r.URL.Path == "/v1/jobs":
		s.serveSubmit(w, r)
	case r.Method == http.MethodGet && strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/v1/jobs/"):
		s.servePoll(w, r)
	case r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/v1/quota" && !s.noQuota:
		s.mu.Lock()
		remaining, reset := s.quota()
		s.mu.Unlock()
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusOK, nil, map[string]any{
			"limit": s.limit, "remaining": remaining, "reset": reset, "window": "P1D",
		})
	default:
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusNotFound, nil, stubError("not_found", "no such resource"))
	}
}

func (s *stub) serveSubmit(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	parts, err := readParts(r)
	key := r.Header.Get("Idempotency-Key")
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.submits++
	n := s.submits
	s.parts = parts
	s.keys = append(s.keys, key)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.submit != nil {
		write(w, s.submit(n))
		return
	}
	retention := "default"
	if p := parts["retention"]; len(p) == 1 {
		retention = string(p[0].data)
	}
	if err != nil || retention != "none" && retention != "default" || len(parts["retention"]) > 1 ||
		slices.ContainsFunc([]string{"document", "extractor_instructions", "judge_instructions", "schema"},
			func(name string) bool { return len(parts[name]) != 1 }) {
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusBadRequest, nil, stubError("bad_request", "a part is missing, repeated or unreadable"))
		return
	}

	digest := partsDigest(parts)
	s.mu.Lock()
	job := s.byKey[key]
	switch {
	case key != "" && job != nil && job.digest != digest:
		s.mu.Unlock()
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, nil, stubError("idempotency_mismatch", "same key, different request"))
		return
	case key != "" && job != nil:
		body := job.render()
		s.mu.Unlock()
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]string{"Location": "/v1/jobs/" + job.id, "Idempotency-Replayed": "true"}, body)
		return
	}
	if remaining, reset := s.quota(); remaining == 0 {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusTooManyRequests, map[string]string{"Retry-After": strconv.Itoa(int(time.Until(reset).Seconds()) + 1)},
			stubError("quota_exhausted", "the quota is spent"))
		return
	}
	doc := parts["document"][0]
	res, err := s.fake.Extract(r.Context(), extract.Request{Document: doc.data, MIME: doc.contentType})
	if err != nil {
		s.mu.Unlock()
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusInternalServerError, nil, stubError("internal", "the fake failed"))
		return
	}
	job = &stubJob{id: rand.Text(), digest: digest, res: res, retention: retention, status: "queued",
		created: time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)}
	s.runs++
	s.jobs[job.id] = job
	if key != "" {
		s.byKey[key] = job
	}
	body := job.render()
	s.mu.Unlock()

	if s.lose != nil && s.lose(n) {
		if conn, _, err := http.NewResponseController(w).Hijack(); err == nil {
			_ = conn.Close()
		}
		return
	}
	s.answer(w, r, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]string{"Location": "/v1/jobs/" + job.id}, body)
}

func (s *stub) servePoll(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.polls++
	n := s.polls
	job := s.jobs[strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/v1/jobs/")]
	gone := job == nil || job.gone
	var body map[string]any
	if !gone {
		job.advance()
		body = job.render()
		// With retention none the first read of a terminal status deletes
		// the content.
		job.gone = job.finished != nil && job.retention == "none"
	}
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if s.poll != nil {
		write(w, s.poll(n))
		return
	}
	if gone {
		s.answer(w, r, http.StatusNotFound, nil, stubError("not_found", "no such job"))
		return
	}
	s.answer(w, r, http.StatusOK, nil, body)
}

// advance moves the job one step per poll: running, then its verdict.
func (j *stubJob) advance() {
	j.polls++
	switch {
	case j.finished != nil:
	case j.polls == 1:
		j.status = "running"
	default:
		j.status = "rejected"
		if j.res.Accepted {
			j.status = "accepted"
		}
		now := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
		j.finished = &now
	}
}

// render is the job resource of the contract, section 5. A job whose
// content is gone keeps only its status.
func (j *stubJob) render() map[string]any {
	m := map[string]any{
		"id": j.id, "status": j.status, "result": nil, "feedback": []extract.FieldFeedback{}, "attempts": 0,
		"service_version": stubVersion, "error": nil,
		"created_at": j.created, "finished_at": j.finished, "expires_at": j.created.Add(stubKeep),
	}
	if j.finished == nil {
		return m
	}
	m["attempts"] = j.res.Attempts
	if j.gone {
		return m
	}
	m["result"] = j.res.JSON
	feedback := []extract.FieldFeedback{}
	for _, f := range j.res.Feedback {
		f.Source = extract.SourceJudge
		feedback = append(feedback, f)
	}
	m["feedback"] = feedback
	return m
}

// quota is what is left of the window and when it resets. Call with s.mu
// held.
func (s *stub) quota() (int, time.Time) {
	reset := time.Now().UTC().Truncate(24 * time.Hour).Add(24 * time.Hour)
	return max(s.limit-s.runs, 0), reset
}

// answer sends v as JSON with the headers the contract puts on every
// authenticated response, and keeps it for TestStubContract.
func (s *stub) answer(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, status int, header map[string]string, v any) {
	body, err := json.Marshal(v)
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	s.mu.Lock()
	remaining, reset := s.quota()
	s.mu.Unlock()
	h := w.Header()
	h.Set("X-Quota-Remaining", strconv.Itoa(remaining))
	h.Set("X-Quota-Reset", reset.Format(time.RFC3339))
	if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/v1/jobs") {
		h.Set("X-Service-Version", stubVersion)
	}
	for k, v := range header {
		h.Set(k, v)
	}
	h.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_, _ = w.Write(body)
	s.mu.Lock()
	s.answers = append(s.answers, stubAnswer{path: r.URL.Path, status: status, header: h.Clone(), body: body})
	s.mu.Unlock()
}

func stubError(code, message string) map[string]any {
	return map[string]any{"error": map[string]string{"code": code, "message": message}}
}

// partsDigest hashes the parts by name, in request order within a name.
func partsDigest(parts map[string][]stubPart) string {
	names := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for name := range parts {
		names = append(names, name)
	}
	slices.Sort(names)
	h := sha256.New()
	for _, name := range names {
		for _, p := range parts[name] {
			_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(h, "%s\x00%s\x00%d\x00", name, p.contentType, len(p.data))
			h.Write(p.data)
		}
	}
	return fmt.Sprintf("%x", h.Sum(nil))
}

func readParts(r *http.Request) (map[string][]stubPart, error) {
	mr, err := r.MultipartReader()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	parts := map[string][]stubPart{}
	for {
		p, err := mr.NextPart()
		if errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
			return parts, nil
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		data, err := io.ReadAll(p)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		parts[p.FormName()] = append(parts[p.FormName()], stubPart{contentType: p.Header.Get("Content-Type"), data: data})
	}
}

func write(w http.ResponseWriter, r reply) {
	for k, v := range r.header {
		w.Header().Set(k, v)
	}
	if r.body != "" {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	}
	w.WriteHeader(r.status)
	_, _ = io.WriteString(w, r.body)
}

// testRequest is a request for doc carrying the real prompts and schema.
func testRequest(doc []byte, mime string, pages ...[]byte) extract.Request {
	p, s := extract.Versions()
	return extract.Request{
		Document: doc, MIME: mime, PageImages: pages,
		ExtractorPrompt: extract.ExtractorInstructions(), JudgePrompt: extract.JudgeInstructions(),
		Schema: extract.Schema(), PromptVersion: p, SchemaVersion: s,
	}
}

func accepted(n int) reply {
	if n == 1 {
		return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"running"}`}
	}
	return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"accepted","result":` + string(result(hotelItem)) +
		`,"feedback":[],"attempts":1,"service_version":"svc-1","error":null}`}
}

func submitted(int) reply {
	return reply{status: http.StatusAccepted, header: map[string]string{"X-Quota-Remaining": "41"}, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"queued"}`}
}

func TestService(t *testing.T) {
	reset := time.Now().Add(3 * time.Hour).UTC().Truncate(time.Second)
	tests := []struct {
		name     string
		submit   func(n int) reply
		poll     func(n int) reply
		deadline time.Duration
		// wantErr is the error class; "" wants a Result.
		wantErr      string
		wantAccepted bool
		wantFeedback string // substring of some feedback message
		check        func(t *testing.T, s *stub, svc *extract.Service, res extract.Result, err error)
	}{
		{
			name: "accepted", submit: submitted, poll: accepted, wantAccepted: true,
			check: func(t *testing.T, s *stub, _ *extract.Service, res extract.Result, _ error) {
				if !jsonEqual(res.JSON, result(hotelItem)) || res.Attempts != 1 || res.ServiceVersion != "svc-1" || len(res.Feedback) != 0 {
					t.Errorf("result = %+v", res)
				}
				if res.QuotaRemaining == nil || *res.QuotaRemaining != 41 {
					t.Errorf("quota remaining = %v, want 41", res.QuotaRemaining)
				}
				if submits, polls := s.counts(); submits != 1 || polls != 2 {
					t.Errorf("%d submits, %d polls; want 1, 2", submits, polls)
				}
				checkParts(t, s)
			},
		},
		{
			name:   "rejected with feedback",
			submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"rejected","result":` + string(result(flightItem)) +
					`,"feedback":[{"pointer":"/reservations/0/starts_at_local","message":"The departure time is unclear."}],` +
					`"attempts":3,"service_version":"svc-1","error":null}`}
			},
			wantFeedback: "departure time is unclear",
			check: func(t *testing.T, _ *stub, _ *extract.Service, res extract.Result, _ error) {
				if !jsonEqual(res.JSON, result(flightItem)) || res.Attempts != 3 || len(res.Feedback) != 1 ||
					res.Feedback[0].Pointer != "/reservations/0/starts_at_local" {
					t.Errorf("result = %+v", res)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name:   "failed",
			submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"failed","result":null,"feedback":[],"attempts":2,` +
					`"service_version":"svc-1","error":{"code":"provider_unavailable","message":"all endpoints failed"}}`}
			},
			wantFeedback: "provider_unavailable",
			check: func(t *testing.T, _ *stub, _ *extract.Service, res extract.Result, _ error) {
				if string(res.JSON) != "null" || res.Attempts != 2 {
					t.Errorf("result = %+v", res)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name:   "accepted with a judge error",
			submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"accepted","result":` + string(result(hotelItem)) +
					`,"feedback":[],"attempts":1,"service_version":"svc-1","error":{"code":"judge_error","message":"judge timed out"}}`}
			},
			wantFeedback: "judge_error",
		},
		{
			name:   "accepted without a result",
			submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"accepted","result":null,"attempts":1,"service_version":"svc-1"}`}
			},
			wantFeedback: "accepted no result",
		},
		{
			name:   "unknown status",
			submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"done","result":` + string(result(hotelItem)) + `,"attempts":1}`}
			},
			wantFeedback: `unknown status "done"`,
		},
		{
			name: "429 then success",
			submit: func(n int) reply {
				if n == 1 {
					return reply{status: http.StatusTooManyRequests, header: map[string]string{"Retry-After": "1", "X-Quota-Remaining": "5"}}
				}
				return submitted(n)
			},
			poll: accepted, wantAccepted: true,
			check: func(t *testing.T, s *stub, _ *extract.Service, _ extract.Result, _ error) {
				if submits, _ := s.counts(); submits != 2 {
					t.Errorf("%d submits, want 2", submits)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "quota exhausted",
			submit: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusTooManyRequests, header: map[string]string{
					"Retry-After": "10800", "X-Quota-Remaining": "0", "X-Quota-Reset": reset.Format(time.RFC3339),
				}}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassQuota,
			check: func(t *testing.T, s *stub, svc *extract.Service, _ extract.Result, err error) {
				var qe *extract.QuotaError
				if !errors.As(err, &qe) || !qe.Reset.Equal(reset) {
					t.Errorf("err = %v, want a QuotaError resetting at %s", err, reset)
				}
				// The next document is refused without asking the service.
				_, err = svc.Extract(t.Context(), testRequest([]byte("next"), "text/plain"))
				if !errors.As(err, &qe) || !qe.Reset.Equal(reset) {
					t.Errorf("second call: err = %v, want a QuotaError resetting at %s", err, reset)
				}
				if submits, _ := s.counts(); submits != 1 {
					t.Errorf("%d submits, want 1", submits)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "rate limited past the deadline", deadline: time.Second,
			submit: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusTooManyRequests, header: map[string]string{"Retry-After": "60"}}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassQuota,
			check: func(t *testing.T, _ *stub, _ *extract.Service, _ extract.Result, err error) {
				var qe *extract.QuotaError
				if !errors.As(err, &qe) || time.Until(qe.Reset) < 50*time.Second {
					t.Errorf("err = %v, want a QuotaError about a minute ahead", err)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "timeout", deadline: 200 * time.Millisecond, submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"running","result":null,"attempts":1}`}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassTimeout,
			check: func(t *testing.T, _ *stub, _ *extract.Service, _ extract.Result, err error) {
				if !errors.Is(err, extract.ErrTimeout) || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "still running") {
					t.Errorf("err = %v, want ErrTimeout while running", err)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "malformed JSON", submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, body: `{"id":"j1","status":"accep`}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassService,
		},
		{
			name: "malformed submit response",
			submit: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusAccepted, body: `<html>`}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassService,
		},
		{
			name: "poll fails once then succeeds", submit: submitted,
			poll: func(n int) reply {
				if n == 1 {
					return reply{status: http.StatusBadGateway}
				}
				return accepted(n)
			},
			wantAccepted: true,
		},
		{
			name: "service version from header", submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusOK, header: map[string]string{"X-Service-Version": "svc-header"},
					body: `{"id":"j1","status":"accepted","result":` + string(result(hotelItem)) + `,"attempts":1}`}
			},
			wantAccepted: true,
			check: func(t *testing.T, _ *stub, _ *extract.Service, res extract.Result, _ error) {
				if res.ServiceVersion != "svc-header" {
					t.Errorf("service version = %q, want svc-header", res.ServiceVersion)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "invalid request",
			submit: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusUnprocessableEntity, body: `{"error":{"code":"unsupported_document","message":"cannot read"}}`}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassInvalid,
			check: func(t *testing.T, _ *stub, _ *extract.Service, _ extract.Result, err error) {
				if !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "unsupported_document") {
					t.Errorf("err = %v, want the service's error code", err)
				}
			},
		},
		{
			name: "outage",
			submit: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassService,
		},
		{
			name: "job lost", submit: submitted,
			poll: func(int) reply {
				return reply{status: http.StatusNotFound}
			},
			wantErr: extract.ClassService,
		},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := newStub(t)
			s.submit, s.poll = tt.submit, tt.poll
			svc := s.service()
			svc.Deadline = tt.deadline
			res, err := svc.Extract(t.Context(), testRequest([]byte("Hotel Avenida, 12 May 2027"), "text/plain; charset=utf-8",
				[]byte("page one"), []byte("page two")))
			if res.Accepted != tt.wantAccepted {
				t.Errorf("accepted = %v, want %v", res.Accepted, tt.wantAccepted)
			}
			switch {
			case tt.wantErr == "" && err != nil:
				t.Fatalf("err = %v, want a result", err)
			case tt.wantErr != "" && err == nil:
				t.Fatalf("no error, want class %s", tt.wantErr)
			case tt.wantErr != "":
				if got := extract.Classify(err); got != tt.wantErr {
					t.Errorf("class of %v = %s, want %s", err, got, tt.wantErr)
				}
			}
			if tt.wantFeedback != "" && !slices.ContainsFunc(res.Feedback, func(f extract.FieldFeedback) bool {
				return strings.Contains(f.Message, tt.wantFeedback)
			}) {
				t.Errorf("feedback = %v, want a message containing %q", res.Feedback, tt.wantFeedback)
			}
			if tt.check != nil {
				tt.check(t, s, svc, res, err)
			}
		})
	}
}

// checkParts checks the multipart body of the last submit.
func checkParts(t *testing.T, s *stub) {
	t.Helper()
	s.mu.Lock()
	parts := s.parts
	s.mu.Unlock()
	one := func(name string) stubPart {
		if len(parts[name]) != 1 {
			t.Fatalf("%d %s parts, want 1", len(parts[name]), name)
		}
		return parts[name][0]
	}
	if d := one("document"); string(d.data) != "Hotel Avenida, 12 May 2027" || d.contentType != "text/plain; charset=utf-8" {
		t.Errorf("document = %q as %q", d.data, d.contentType)
	}
	if pages := parts["page"]; len(pages) != 2 || string(pages[0].data) != "page one" || pages[1].contentType != "image/png" {
		t.Errorf("pages = %v", pages)
	}
	if string(one("extractor_instructions").data) != extract.ExtractorInstructions() ||
		string(one("judge_instructions").data) != extract.JudgeInstructions() {
		t.Error("instructions not sent verbatim")
	}
	if sc := one("schema"); string(sc.data) != string(extract.Schema()) || sc.contentType != "application/schema+json" {
		t.Errorf("schema sent as %q", sc.contentType)
	}
	if string(one("retention").data) != "none" {
		t.Error("retention is not none")
	}
}

func TestServiceUnauthorized(t *testing.T) {
	s := newStub(t)
	svc := s.service()
	svc.Token = "wrong"
	_, err := svc.Extract(t.Context(), testRequest([]byte("x"), "text/plain"))
	if err == nil || extract.Classify(err) != extract.ClassService || !strings.Contains(err.Error(), "401") {
		t.Errorf("err = %v, want a service error with status 401", err)
	}
}

// TestServiceOutage runs the extract job against a service answering 503 to
// everything: the document stays processing while River retries, and is
// never done.
func TestServiceOutage(t *testing.T) {
	e := newJobEnv(t)
	s := newStub(t)
	s.submit = func(int) reply { return reply{status: http.StatusServiceUnavailable} }
	s.poll = s.submit
	j := e.job(s.service())

	t.Run("attempts", func(t *testing.T) {
		d := e.newDoc(t, pgtype.UUID{})
		for n := 1; n < jobs.ExtractMaxAttempts; n++ {
			err := e.attempt(t, j, d, n)
			if err == nil || extract.Classify(err) != extract.ClassService {
				t.Fatalf("attempt %d: err = %v, want a service error to retry", n, err)
			}
			if status, _ := e.state(t, d.ID); status != extract.StatusProcessing {
				t.Fatalf("after attempt %d: status %s, want processing", n, status)
			}
		}
		// The last attempt gives up with a reason; the document is never done.
		_ = e.attempt(t, j, d, jobs.ExtractMaxAttempts)
		status, r := e.state(t, d.ID)
		if status != extract.StatusFailed || classOf(r) != extract.ClassService {
			t.Errorf("after the last attempt: %s with class %q, want failed with service", status, classOf(r))
		}
	})

	t.Run("river retries", func(t *testing.T) {
		d := e.newDoc(t, pgtype.UUID{})
		jc, err := jobs.New(e.pool, e.logger, e.blobs, jobs.WithExtraction(j.Work))
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := jc.Start(context.WithoutCancel(t.Context())); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		t.Cleanup(func() {
			ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
			defer cancel()
			if err := jc.Stop(ctx); err != nil {
				t.Error(err)
			}
		})
		tx, err := e.pool.Begin(t.Context())
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := jc.EnqueueTx(t.Context(), tx, jobs.ExtractArgs{DocumentID: d.ID}); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if err := tx.Commit(t.Context()); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}

		deadline := time.Now().Add(30 * time.Second)
		for {
			var state string
			var attempt, errs int
			err := e.pool.QueryRow(t.Context(), `SELECT state, attempt, coalesce(array_length(errors, 1), 0)
				FROM river_job WHERE kind = 'extract' AND args->>'document_id' = $1`, d.ID.String()).Scan(&state, &attempt, &errs)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if state == string(rivertype.JobStateRetryable) {
				if attempt != 1 || errs != 1 {
					t.Errorf("retryable after attempt %d with %d errors, want 1 and 1", attempt, errs)
				}
				break
			}
			if state != string(rivertype.JobStateAvailable) && state != string(rivertype.JobStateRunning) {
				t.Fatalf("job state %s, want retryable", state)
			}
			if time.Now().After(deadline) {
				t.Fatalf("job still %s after 30 s", state)
			}
			time.Sleep(50 * time.Millisecond)
		}
		if status, _ := e.state(t, d.ID); status != extract.StatusProcessing {
			t.Errorf("status %s while River retries, want processing", status)
		}
	})
}

// TestServiceLive runs against the real extraction service at EXTRACTION_URL
// with EXTRACTION_TOKEN, and is skipped when EXTRACTION_URL is not set.
func TestServiceLive(t *testing.T) {
	url := os.Getenv("EXTRACTION_URL")
	if url == "" {
		t.Skip("EXTRACTION_URL is not set; live extraction service tests skipped")
	}
	svc := &extract.Service{URL: url, Token: os.Getenv("EXTRACTION_TOKEN")}

	t.Run("one document", func(t *testing.T) {
		res, err := svc.Extract(t.Context(), testRequest(
			[]byte("Ferry Lisbon to Barreiro, 12 May 2027 09:15, booking ref LX42QZ, passenger Ana Silva."),
			"text/plain; charset=utf-8"))
		if errors.Is(err, extract.ErrQuota) {
			t.Skipf("quota: %v", err)
		}
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		if res.ServiceVersion == "" || res.Attempts < 1 {
			t.Errorf("service version %q, attempts %d", res.ServiceVersion, res.Attempts)
		}
		if res.Accepted && !json.Valid(res.JSON) {
			t.Error("accepted result is not JSON")
		}
		if !res.Accepted && len(res.Feedback) == 0 {
			t.Error("not accepted without feedback")
		}
	})

	t.Run("corpus end to end", func(t *testing.T) {
		runCorpus(t, newJobEnv(t), svc, time.Hour, false)
	})
}

func jsonEqual(a, b []byte) bool {
	var x, y any
	if json.Unmarshal(a, &x) != nil || json.Unmarshal(b, &y) != nil {
		return false
	}
	ja, _ := json.Marshal(x)
	jb, _ := json.Marshal(y)
	return string(ja) == string(jb)
}

// TestServiceIdempotency loses the response to the first submission: the
// retry carries the same Idempotency-Key, gets the first job back and the
// stub runs the Fake once. A replayed job whose content is already gone is
// submitted afresh.
func TestServiceIdempotency(t *testing.T) {
	s := newStub(t)
	s.lose = func(n int) bool { return n == 1 }
	svc := s.service()
	req := testRequest([]byte("Hotel Avenida, 12 May 2027"), "text/plain; charset=utf-8")

	if _, err := svc.Extract(t.Context(), req); err == nil || extract.Classify(err) != extract.ClassService {
		t.Fatalf("lost response: err = %v, want a service error to retry", err)
	}
	res, err := svc.Extract(t.Context(), req)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("retry: %v", err)
	}
	if res.Accepted || len(res.Feedback) != 1 || res.Feedback[0].Source != extract.SourceJudge {
		t.Errorf("retry: result %+v, want rejected with judge feedback", res)
	}
	keys := s.sentKeys()
	if created := s.created(); len(keys) != 2 || created != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("%d submits created %d jobs, want 2 and 1", len(keys), created)
	}
	if keys[0] == "" || keys[1] != keys[0] {
		t.Errorf("keys %q, want the same key twice", keys)
	}
	if res.QuotaRemaining == nil || *res.QuotaRemaining != stubQuota-1 {
		t.Errorf("quota remaining %v, want %d", res.QuotaRemaining, stubQuota-1)
	}

	// The job was read with retention none: the key now names a 404.
	if _, err := svc.Extract(t.Context(), req); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("after the job is gone: %v", err)
	}
	keys = s.sentKeys()
	if created := s.created(); created != 2 || len(keys) != 4 || keys[2] != keys[0] || keys[3] != "" {
		t.Errorf("%d jobs from keys %q, want 2 with the fresh submission keyless", created, keys)
	}
}

func TestIdempotencyKey(t *testing.T) {
	s := newStub(t)
	svc := s.service()
	// key is the key the first submission of req carries. Repeats may be
	// refused as an idempotency_mismatch; only the key matters here.
	key := func(req extract.Request) string {
		t.Helper()
		n := len(s.sentKeys())
		_, _ = svc.Extract(t.Context(), req)
		keys := s.sentKeys()
		if len(keys) <= n {
			t.Fatal("nothing submitted")
		}
		return keys[n]
	}
	original := sha256.Sum256([]byte("the original .eml"))
	withHash := func(doc string, prompt int) extract.Request {
		req := testRequest([]byte(doc), "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
		req.ContentHash, req.PromptVersion = original[:], prompt
		return req
	}

	base := withHash("the body", 7)
	want := sha256.Sum256(fmt.Appendf(append([]byte{}, original[:]...), "\x00%d\x00%d", 7, base.SchemaVersion))
	if got := key(base); got != fmt.Sprintf("%x", want) {
		t.Errorf("key %s, want hex(sha256(content hash, prompt version, schema version)) %x", got, want)
	}
	if key(withHash("another rendition", 7)) != key(base) {
		t.Error("the key depends on the rendition, not only on the original's content hash")
	}
	if key(withHash("the body", 8)) == key(base) {
		t.Error("a new prompt version keeps the key")
	}
	noHash := testRequest([]byte("pasted text"), "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
	wantDoc := sha256.Sum256(fmt.Appendf([]byte("pasted text"), "\x00%d\x00%d", noHash.PromptVersion, noHash.SchemaVersion))
	if got := key(noHash); got != fmt.Sprintf("%x", wantDoc) {
		t.Errorf("key without a content hash %s, want one over the document bytes %x", got, wantDoc)
	}
}

func TestServiceCheck(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name    string
		token   string
		limit   int
		noQuota bool
		wantErr error
	}{
		{name: "quota", token: stubToken, limit: stubQuota},
		{name: "spent quota", token: stubToken, limit: 0},
		{name: "unauthorized", token: "wrong", limit: stubQuota, wantErr: extract.ErrInvalid},
		{name: "forbidden", token: stubScopelessToken, limit: stubQuota, wantErr: extract.ErrInvalid},
		{name: "no quota endpoint", token: stubToken, limit: stubQuota, noQuota: true, wantErr: extract.ErrNoQuotaEndpoint},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			s := newStub(t)
			s.limit, s.noQuota = tt.limit, tt.noQuota
			svc := s.service()
			svc.Token = tt.token
			q, err := svc.Check(t.Context())
			if tt.wantErr != nil {
				if !errors.Is(err, tt.wantErr) {
					t.Fatalf("err = %v, want %v", err, tt.wantErr)
				}
				if tt.noQuota && errors.Is(err, extract.ErrInvalid) {
					t.Errorf("err = %v: a missing endpoint is not a bad credential", err)
				}
				return
			}
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if q.Limit != tt.limit || q.Remaining != tt.limit || q.Window != "P1D" || !q.Reset.After(time.Now()) {
				t.Errorf("quota %+v, want %d of %d left, P1D, resetting ahead", q, tt.limit, tt.limit)
			}
			if tt.limit > 0 {
				return
			}
			// The quota Check read is remembered: nothing is submitted.
			_, err = svc.Extract(t.Context(), testRequest([]byte("x"), "text/plain"))
			var qe *extract.QuotaError
			if !errors.As(err, &qe) || !qe.Reset.Equal(q.Reset) {
				t.Errorf("err = %v, want a QuotaError until %s", err, q.Reset)
			}
			if submits, _ := s.counts(); submits != 0 {
				t.Errorf("%d submits after a spent quota, want 0", submits)
			}
		})
	}
}

// serviceContract is the extraction service's OpenAPI file, relative to this
// package.
const serviceContract = "../../../shared/extraction-service-api.yaml"

// contractRequired reads the required fields of the named component schemas
// from serviceContract. Its layout is regular enough for a line scan: schema
// names at four spaces, their required lists at six.
func contractRequired(t *testing.T, names ...string) map[string][]string {
	t.Helper()
	data, err := os.ReadFile(serviceContract)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	out := map[string][]string{}
	schema := ""
	for line := range strings.Lines(string(data)) {
		line = strings.TrimRight(line, "\r\n")
		if name, ok := strings.CutPrefix(line, "    "); ok && name != "" && name[0] != ' ' && strings.HasSuffix(name, ":") {
			schema = strings.TrimSuffix(name, ":")
			continue
		}
		list, ok := strings.CutPrefix(line, "      required: [")
		if !ok || !slices.Contains(names, schema) || out[schema] != nil {
			continue
		}
		for f := range strings.SplitSeq(strings.TrimSuffix(list, "]"), ",") {
			out[schema] = append(out[schema], strings.TrimSpace(f))
		}
	}
	for _, name := range names {
		if len(out[name]) == 0 {
			t.Fatalf("%s: no required fields found for %s", serviceContract, name)
		}
	}
	return out
}

// contractJob is the Job schema of serviceContract.
type contractJob struct {
	ID             string            `json:"id"`
	Status         string            `json:"status"`
	Result         json.RawMessage   `json:"result"`
	Feedback       []json.RawMessage `json:"feedback"`
	Attempts       int               `json:"attempts"`
	ServiceVersion string            `json:"service_version"`
	Error          *struct {
		Code    string `json:"code"`
		Message string `json:"message"`
	} `json:"error"`
	CreatedAt  time.Time  `json:"created_at"`
	FinishedAt *time.Time `json:"finished_at"`
	ExpiresAt  time.Time  `json:"expires_at"`
}

// TestStubContract holds the stub to serviceContract: every job, quota and
// error body it sends has each required field, no field the contract does not
// name, and the contract's types; every response carries the quota headers.
func TestStubContract(t *testing.T) {
	required := contractRequired(t, "Job", "FeedbackEntry", "Quota")
	s := newStub(t)
	svc := s.service()
	if _, err := svc.Check(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	dir, err := (&extract.Fake{}).CorpusDir()
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	sources, err := filepath.Glob(filepath.Join(dir, "*", "source.*"))
	if err != nil || len(sources) == 0 {
		t.Fatalf("corpus: %d sources, %v", len(sources), err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(sources[0])
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	known := testRequest(data, corpusMIME[filepath.Ext(sources[0])])
	sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
	known.ContentHash = sum[:]
	unknown := testRequest([]byte("not in the corpus"), "text/plain; charset=utf-8")
	for _, req := range []extract.Request{known, unknown, unknown} {
		if _, err := svc.Extract(t.Context(), req); err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}

	strict := func(body []byte, v any) error {
		dec := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(body)))
		dec.DisallowUnknownFields()
		return dec.Decode(v)
	}
	missing := func(body []byte, fields []string) []string {
		var m map[string]json.RawMessage
		if err := json.Unmarshal(body, &m); err != nil {
			return []string{err.Error()}
		}
		var out []string
		for _, f := range fields {
			if _, ok := m[f]; !ok {
				out = append(out, f)
			}
		}
		return out
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	s.mu.Lock()
	answers := slices.Clone(s.answers)
	s.mu.Unlock()
	for i, a := range answers {
		where := fmt.Sprintf("answer %d (%d to %s)", i, a.status, a.path)
		if a.header.Get("X-Quota-Remaining") == "" || a.header.Get("X-Quota-Reset") == "" {
			t.Errorf("%s: no quota headers", where)
		}
		switch {
		case a.path == "/v1/quota":
			if m := missing(a.body, required["Quota"]); len(m) > 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s: missing %v", where, m)
			}
			var q struct {
				Limit     int       `json:"limit"`
				Remaining int       `json:"remaining"`
				Reset     time.Time `json:"reset"`
				Window    string    `json:"window"`
			}
			if err := strict(a.body, &q); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("%s: %v", where, err)
			}
			seen["quota"] = true
		case a.status == http.StatusOK || a.status == http.StatusAccepted:
			if m := missing(a.body, required["Job"]); len(m) > 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s: missing %v", where, m)
			}
			var j contractJob
			if err := strict(a.body, &j); err != nil {
				t.Errorf("%s: %v", where, err)
				continue
			}
			terminal := j.Status == "accepted" || j.Status == "rejected" || j.Status == "failed"
			if !terminal && j.Status != "queued" && j.Status != "running" {
				t.Errorf("%s: status %q", where, j.Status)
			}
			if j.ID == "" || j.ServiceVersion == "" || a.header.Get("X-Service-Version") != j.ServiceVersion {
				t.Errorf("%s: id %q, service version %q, header %q", where, j.ID, j.ServiceVersion, a.header.Get("X-Service-Version"))
			}
			if terminal != (j.FinishedAt != nil) || j.CreatedAt.IsZero() || !j.ExpiresAt.After(j.CreatedAt) {
				t.Errorf("%s: %s created %v, finished %v, expires %v", where, j.Status, j.CreatedAt, j.FinishedAt, j.ExpiresAt)
			}
			if r := strings.TrimSpace(string(j.Result)); r != "null" && !strings.HasPrefix(r, "{") ||
				j.Status == "accepted" && r == "null" || j.Error != nil || j.Attempts < 0 {
				t.Errorf("%s: result %.40s, error %v, attempts %d", where, r, j.Error, j.Attempts)
			}
			for _, f := range j.Feedback {
				var e struct {
					Pointer string `json:"pointer"`
					Message string `json:"message"`
					Source  string `json:"source"`
				}
				if m := missing(f, required["FeedbackEntry"]); len(m) > 0 {
					t.Errorf("%s: feedback missing %v", where, m)
				}
				if err := strict(f, &e); err != nil || e.Source != "judge" && e.Source != "schema" {
					t.Errorf("%s: feedback %s: %v", where, f, err)
				}
			}
			seen[j.Status] = true
			if a.header.Get("Idempotency-Replayed") == "true" {
				seen["replayed"] = true
			}
		default:
			var e struct {
				Error struct {
					Code    string `json:"code"`
					Message string `json:"message"`
				} `json:"error"`
			}
			if err := strict(a.body, &e); err != nil || e.Error.Code == "" {
				t.Errorf("%s: error body %s: %v", where, a.body, err)
			}
			seen[strconv.Itoa(a.status)] = true
		}
	}
	for _, want := range []string{"quota", "queued", "running", "accepted", "rejected", "replayed", "404"} {
		if !seen[want] {
			t.Errorf("no %s answer among %d", want, len(answers))
		}
	}
}
